dedupe_keys.name: post earthquake hospital transportation for casualties agent based model data and code

description: This package holds the data and code of an agent-based model of how earthquake casualties are transported to hospitals, used to study post-earthquake emergency medical response. It was published by Carlos Mesta of the University School for Advanced Studies (IUSS) Pavia; version 1.1.0 was archived on Zenodo on 6 June 2024 from the GitHub repository. The model combines MATLAB scripts, which prepare inputs and analyse results, with a simulation in the GAMA agent-based platform, in which casualties, vehicles and hospitals interact on a road network that may be damaged by the earthquake. Coverage: the study area and scenario of the accompanying research; the Zenodo record does not name it. Access: a 12 MB archive on Zenodo and the source repository. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free, though MATLAB is commercial and GAMA must be installed. Caveats: research code with a very short description; assumptions are documented only in the paper and repository. Simulation uses are testing hospital capacity and ambulance strategies after earthquakes and road-damage effects on access to critical facilities. Related records: the AntifragiCity AHEPA hospital model and Bedreflyt.
